purpose: Resume the C36 experiment after repairing a latent defect in the inherited C35 static-query checker. The hypothesis under test is unchanged and still unmeasured: whether diagonal two-support is statically infeasible at the frozen nominal crouch, because the whole-body COM sits 21.7 mm forward of the wheel contact rectangle centre.

why_a_second_attempt_is_not_a_retry.c36_attempt_1_produced: 205 controls, 1025 normal native substeps, zero native safety violations, and the first physical confirmation that the pre-unload correction works: at native 1020 to 1024, the exact substep and state where C35 raised, the stance-pair gate passes with the swing wheel at 0.0 N and the stance pair carrying 458.6 N against a 236.2 N requirement.
why_a_second_attempt_is_not_a_retry.c36_attempt_1_did_not_produce: any physics result on the statics hypothesis. It never reached sustained two-support. It terminated on an AttributeError inside a static-query assertion, not on a controlled quality failure and not on a native safety gate.
why_a_second_attempt_is_not_a_retry.distinction: The no-retry rule exists so a controlled quality or physics failure is not re-run to fish for a better outcome. This is a different category: an unexercised assertion in inherited source crashed on the installed MuJoCo binding. C37 is a new bounded campaign with its own GO, its own directory and its own single attempt. Budget is recorded additively, never reallocated from C36.

the_defect.frozen_expression: packed = isinstance(args[2], np.ndarray) and np.shares_memory(args[2], self.scratch.qM)
the_defect.fault: MuJoCo 3.12.0 exposes the inertia as MjData.M and has no qM at all. The repository's d1_fast_side_step._dense_inertia already handles both bindings and correctly takes the modern mj_fullM(model, data, matrix) branch, so `modern` is already True, but the checker evaluates the legacy `packed` branch unconditionally and dereferences the missing attribute.
the_defect.why_it_was_never_seen: C35 stopped at control 204, before any coupled-inertia computation. Its own ledger records fullM: 0. The defect sat unexercised for a whole contract.
the_defect.repair: Short-circuit only. The acceptance predicate stays exactly `modern or packed`; `packed` is evaluated only when the modern binding was not used and only when the scratch actually exposes the legacy attribute. The registered-scratch requirement, the explicit-swing-pair requirement, the counting and the 6x6 cache extraction are unchanged.
the_defect.verification: 7 pure tests, including one that asserts the frozen expression genuinely raises AttributeError on the real input, and one that asserts C37 agrees with the frozen predicate on every combination where the frozen predicate could run at all.

hypothesis_under_test.prediction: The campaign enters sustained two-support and then fails a stance-pair load or pose gate, because the COM is 16.5 to 17.1 mm off whichever diagonal supports it while the measured contact-patch moment capacity is only 12.42 mm of arm, a deficit of 1.34 to 1.38 times.
hypothesis_under_test.falsifier: If two-support holds and pair exchanges complete, the statics analysis was too conservative, most likely because the real contact patch carries more moment than the two saved contact slots imply. That outcome is equally informative and must be reported as a correction to docs/ad_lateral_gait_review_20261004.md.
hypothesis_under_test.secondary_measurement: Record the actual per-pair contact-admission waits whatever the outcome. That number decides whether reinforcement learning has any speed headroom at all; see docs/ad_lateral_rl_contract_20261005.md.
